name: cert-warden-devtools
description: CI/dev tooling only — this repo ships bash, not JavaScript. Holds the lockfile-pinned commitlint stack used by the ci.yml commitlint job (scripts/ci/lint-commits.mjs) and the local commit-msg hook. The lockfile's integrity hashes are the supply-chain pin: always install with `npm ci --ignore-scripts`. Why not wagoid/commitlint-github-action: its SHA pin pulled a mutable Docker Hub tag at runtime — the pin froze the wrapper, not the executed code (docs/security-tooling.md).
